title: Bionl_Lean_Call parameters
description: A germline variant-calling workflow focused on ACMG Secondary Findings (research use only), with standardized QC, annotation, and per-sample reports.

run_variant_calling.title: Run Variant Calling
run_variant_calling.description: If true, run variant calling. If false, run post-processing only.

input.title: Samplesheet CSV
input.description: CSV file for variant calling input. Required if run_variant_calling = true.

outdir.title: Output directory
outdir.description: Where to write results (local path or gs://).

variant_calling_outdir.title: Existing variant calling results directory
variant_calling_outdir.description: Use a pre-run variant calling results folder if run_variant_calling=false. Cannot be used with post_samplesheet.

post_samplesheet.title: Post-only samplesheet CSV
post_samplesheet.description: CSV with sample,vcf,bam for post-variant calling mode. Cannot be used with variant_calling_outdir.

fastq_preprocessing.title: FASTQ Preprocessing
fastq_preprocessing.description: Trim fastq file or handle UMIs

trim_fastq.help_text: Use this to perform adapter trimming. Adapter are detected automatically by using the FastP flag `--detect_adapter_for_pe`. For more info see [FastP](https://github.com/OpenGene/fastp).

clip_r1.description: Remove bp from the 5' end of read 1
clip_r1.help_text: This may be useful if the qualities were very poor, or if there is some sort of unwanted bias at the 5' end. Corresponds to the FastP flag `--trim_front1`.

clip_r2.description: Remove bp from the 5' end of read 2
clip_r2.help_text: This may be useful if the qualities were very poor, or if there is some sort of unwanted bias at the 5' end. Corresponds to the FastP flag `--trim_front2`.

three_prime_clip_r1.description: Remove bp from the 3' end of read 1
three_prime_clip_r1.help_text: This may remove some unwanted bias from the 3'.  Corresponds to the FastP flag `--trim_tail1`.

three_prime_clip_r2.description: Remove bp from the 3' end of read 2
three_prime_clip_r2.help_text: This may remove some unwanted bias from the 3' end. Corresponds to the FastP flag `--trim_tail2`.

trim_nextseq.help_text: DetectS polyG in read tails and trim them. Corresponds to the FastP flag `--trim_poly_g`.

length_required.description: Minimum length of reads to keep
length_required.help_text: This is the minimum length of reads to keep after trimming. Corresponds to the FastP flag `--length_required` (default in FastP is 15bp).

umi_read_structure.help_text:
One structure if UMI is present on one end (i.e. '+T 2M11S+T'), or two structures separated by a blank space if UMIs a present on both ends (i.e. '2M11S+T 2M11S+T'); please note, this does not handle duplex-UMIs.

For more info on UMI usage in the pipeline, also check docs [here](./docs/usage/#how-to-handle-umis).

group_by_umi_strategy.help_text: Available values: Identity, Edit, Adjacency, Paired

save_split_fastqs.description: If set, publishes split FASTQ files. Intended for testing purposes.

not.description: Cannot provide both post_samplesheet and variant_calling_outdir

then.description: When run_variant_calling=true you must provide input (samplesheet) and outdir.

else.description: When run_variant_calling=false you must provide outdir and either post_samplesheet OR variant_calling_outdir (not both).
